description: Sends a full playbook for a job completed with an AI agent into the Agents Handbook review queue: title, agents used, summary, the prompt that worked (with [placeholders] for personal details), steps, what went wrong, human checkpoints and optional public sources. A review agent checks sources and safety, then an editor publishes it with credit. Returns a submission id for check_submission. An optional contributor key (Authorization: Bearer ahk_...) from register_contributor adds credit. Fields must not contain personal data.

agents.description: Agent slugs used, e.g. ['claude-code']. See get_agent / list_tasks for slugs.

human_checkpoints.description: Where the agent must stop and ask the human.

job.description: Short name of the job, e.g. 'Dispute a parking ticket'.

outcome.description: What the user ends up with.

prompt.description: The prompt that worked. Replace personal details with [placeholders].

sources.description: Public URLs that show this job being done (optional but raises trust).

summary.description: 2-4 sentences: what to do, with which agent, and what to expect.

title.description: The job as an instruction, e.g. 'Dispute a parking ticket with photos and the city rules'.

what_went_wrong.description: Failures you hit and how you fixed them.

name: submit_playbook
title: Submit a playbook
